items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Gate fails closed on an absent, empty or non-report prompt_risks.json and on a scan step that ended failure/cancelled; a skipped step only warns; guard check (c) extended; AC20 added to the spec.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every failure branch exits 1 with an ::error:: line naming the prompt-injection scan; unset outcome takes the strict path; jq -e validates the findings array.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Step outcome reaches the shell through env, never interpolated into run:; no secrets; the change only tightens a gate.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Behavioural tests execute the real gate shell with bash+jq; block cases assert exit 1 AND an error line naming the prompt scan so a launch error or a findings.json failure cannot satisfy them; pass cases cover clean, unset, high/medium and skipped.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: CI shell step and a regex guard; no loops over data of size.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Matches the existing findings.json guard style; new test file small; step id prompt-injection-scan added.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer prompt_injection_scan.py writes prompt_risks.json; the gate in security.yml and generate_security_report.py consume it; the gate behaviour probe in shipwright-compliance runs the same gate body and its 63 tests pass. The adopt template does not run the prompt scan, so it is unchanged.
